toolApproval.title: Tool Approval Required
toolApproval.notificationBody: Return to Atomic Chat to review the pending action.
toolApproval.securityNotice: Malicious tools or conversation content could potentially trick the assistant into attempting harmful actions. Review each tool call carefully before approving.
toolApproval.permissionScope: Permissions granted apply only to this conversation.

exec.description: The assistant wants to run it on your computer. Permissions granted apply only to this conversation.
exec.unsandboxed: Runs on your computer with your permissions, in this chat's folder. Review it before you allow it.
exec.secure: Runs in the Windows sandbox of this secure project: it can reach only this chat's folder and the project's folders ({{folders}}); everything else on your computer is blocked.
exec.secureNoFolders: Runs in the Windows sandbox of this secure project: it can reach only this chat's folder; everything else on your computer is blocked.

native.catalogDescription: Lists tool names, descriptions and availability. This does not read file contents, change files or run commands.
native.describeDescription: Shows the selected tool’s description and accepted parameters. It does not execute that tool.
native.inspectDescription: Shows a stored action awaiting approval. It does not execute the action.
native.runDescription: Requests the tool shown below with the supplied parameters. Actions requiring a separate confirmation will be shown before execution.
native.confirmDescription: Executes the pending action shown below using its stored arguments. Review the target and parameters before allowing it.
native.threadScope: Allow Once covers this request. Allow in thread remembers access to Personal native tools in this chat; stored action confirmations still require separate approval.

toolApproval.persistentScope: Always allow remembers access to {{tool}} from {{source}} across chats and app restarts. You can revoke it in Settings → General → Tool permissions. Separate native action confirmations still apply.
toolApproval.freshOnly: This approval applies only to this stored action. Remembered tool permissions do not approve other stored actions.
toolApproval.storedActionScope: Always allow applies only to this exact tool, arguments and action scope. A changed command, path or provider requires approval again.
toolApproval.storedActionManage: You can revoke remembered actions in Settings → General → Tool permissions.

permissions.title: Tool permissions
permissions.description: Choose which tools may run without asking in Restricted chats. Full access still auto-approves calls. Native action confirmations are also automatic in Full access. Revoking a tool also clears its remembered thread approvals. Turning off the connector or tool still prevents execution.
permissions.settingsDescription: Manage tools you always allow across conversations and restarts.
permissions.failed: Could not load available tools. Saved permissions remain visible.
permissions.empty: No matching tools. Connect a tool service to see its tools here.
permissions.unavailable: Not currently available, or its connection or schema changed. This saved permission no longer applies to the current tool.

features.title: Semantic memory settings
features.description: Disabled by default. Uses only the local embedding endpoint you configure; no model is downloaded or started. Search falls back to keywords if it is unavailable. Existing notes are indexed only when you request indexing.
features.failed: Could not update Personal feature settings.
features.maintenanceDescription: Disabled by default. Distills related older notes into lessons and procedures on the existing background model. Original notes remain archived. Pauses for conversation.
